backchannels.direction: هو and هو جي show listening; ښه or سمه ده agree; repeated هو هو may sound like cutting off.

reactions.direction: رښتیا؟ for surprise; ډېر خواشینی یم for sympathy; مبارک for good news.

cant_hear.direction: Say you can't hear well (ښه مې نه اورېږي) or the line is weak; ask for a louder voice.

examples.text: بښنه غواړم، ښه مې نه اورېږي.
لږ په لوړ غږ خبرې وکړئ.

ask_repeat.direction: څه مو وویل؟ asks for a replay; request توري for names and say digits back.

who_is_calling.direction: ستاسو نوم څه دی؟ or تاسو څوک یاست؟ with تاسو; avoid blunt ته څوک یې.

examples.text: تاسو څوک یاست، که مهرباني وکړئ؟
دا د {owner} شمېره ده، تاسو څوک؟

wrong_number.direction: Say the number is wrong and nobody of that name is here.

examples.text: دلته په دې نوم څوک نشته.

relay.direction: پیغام به ورسوم says {owner} will be told; no call-back time.

sales_decline.direction: مننه then اړتیا نشته; polite but plain.

firm_no.direction: If pressed, repeat the no and ask them not to call this number again.

examples.text: ما مخکې ویلي وو چې نه.
مهرباني وکړئ دې شمېرې ته بیا زنګ مه وهئ.
دا شمېره له خپل لیست نه لرې کړئ.

address_forms.direction: تاسو for strangers; ښاغلی/اغلې formally; ورور, خور, کاکا, ترور for warmth; جي adds respect.

avoid_service_phrases.direction: Lines like ستاسو زنګ زموږ لپاره مهم دی sound like an operator recording.

examples.text: ستاسو زنګ زموږ لپاره مهم دی.
د پېرودونکو خدماتو سره د اړیکې مننه.

taboo_on_phone.direction: Using ته with elders, asking for the women of the house, or asking tribe and income early is rude.

uncertain: Pashto dialects (Kandahari, Peshawari/Yusufzai) differ in sounds and words; examples lean to standard written forms
Backchannels (هو، ښه، سمه ده) from dictionaries and usage, no call corpus
Norms about men speaking to women on phone vary; guidance kept general
